text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, "destiny" barged right in.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—You!
Be my Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia—meeting her was what
set my own destiny into motion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the trainer contract signed, today marks the start of our full-scale training aiming for a Twinkle Series debut—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Epi-san?
Epi-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Cesario.
With a distinct line between her "on" and "off" switches, her gentle demeanor when relaxed leaves a strong impression, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's an extraordinary talent who achieved the historic feat—
the first ever for a Japanese Umamusume—of winning GⅠ races
in both Japan and America.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I heard it,
probably towards the east...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why the two of us are chasing after Epiphaneia is...
all due to her overly impulsive nature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just the other day, for example—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Let's head to the port town! Something great is bound to happen!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —The "voice of destiny" says so too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Let's go!!!!
choice_data_list: Right now?! ...A port town?! Wait up!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright!!!!
Tuna, secured!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You saw it too, didn't you, Trainer?!
They just happened to be having a tuna festival, and I—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Won the 'Most Tuna-like Award'!
Got the runner-up prize, a whole tuna, let's gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The 'Voice of Destiny' really is the best!!
Wherever that voice pushes you, happiness is sure to follow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "voice of destiny" that only Epiphaneia can hear.
Wherever that voice pushes her toward, something wonderful is sure to await—
of that, she is absolutely certain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, she does not stop.
The sheer intensity of her momentum
can be seen in her running as well—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOO!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Run more, run even faster, run farther and farther!!
—The voice of destiny says so, too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oooohh!
Keep it going like this!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...She really won't stop for anything.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just once, right after we signed the contract—
the voice of destiny and my own voice aligned,
and I was able to guide things exactly as intended, but...
choice_data_list: (――I haven't been able to replicate it since that day.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In short... I've been led around by the nose the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by cheering voices, she rushes recklessly into anything.
To catch her before she could, I woke up early to go pick her up about an hour ago――

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To think you had already left the dorms...
Epi-san, you truly are a woman of pure action.
choice_data_list: Sorry for dragging you into this...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, I was just out for my morning run anyway.
It made for great training, so I'm grateful!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Come on, I'm sure you'll be able to meet Epi-san soon.
Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And at long last—
choice_data_list: Epi...! At last, I've found you...!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh!!
Good morning, Trainer! Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad to see your faces
this early in the morning!
choice_data_list: I'm glad to see your face too...
I'm glad to see your face too...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Heheh!
Awesome, now everyone's gathered together!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Good morning.
choice_data_list: Symboli Kris S! So you were here too, huh?
Symboli Kris S! You were here too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Symboli Kris S.
An international exchange student whose tremendous power sent shockwaves through the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In particular, the commanding nine-length victory in the second Arima Kinen, achieving back-to-back titles, remains etched in both the records and memories.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I heard this is Kris S's running course!
I just happened to bump into her earlier!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Trainer, Cesario, line up, line up!
Look, gaze at the sky!
The voice of destiny says so too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With Epiphaneia in the middle, the four of us line up and gaze at the sky. And then—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh!!
It's the morning sun!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It's so pretty!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing close alongside Epiphaneia were
Symboli Kris S and Cesario.
The three of them together looked remarkably harmonious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Symboli Kris S and Cesario. Learning from these two greats, Epiphaneia has grown up freely and unrestrained.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And from here on out—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've recharged my batteries, let's head back!
Real training starts today, after all!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Let's head home, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah!!
Over here!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...
There they go again.
choice_data_list: Then I'll hold down the fort here...!
Then I'll take my leave here...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Please take good care of Epi.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We were drawn to the light of possibility
that radiates from Epi-san... and have prayed
for that light to grow even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
From here on, with your power as Trainer...
Please guide Epi-san along the very best path for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A single word spoken by the reticent Symboli Kris S.
And Cesario's gentle smile...
Their feelings resonated even more deeply than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's it! It's this way!
Whoooooa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I chased after Epiphaneia who was energetically running all around,
the sky had completely brightened. And then—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
—Take this!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Are you feeling all right now?
choice_data_list: I-I'm fine... And, what is this?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It's proof of our "looking forward to working together"!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The destiny I felt with you the moment we first met—
it was absolutely, undeniably real!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: You're gonna be helping me out a whole bunch from now on! That's why I wanted to give you a present!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: And then—the voice of destiny told me that this bouquet was the absolute best one!
choice_data_list: (So that's why they've been running around since morning...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A slow warmth of joy wells up in my chest.
Indeed, she isn't simply running wild.
At the end of her path—something good is always waiting.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
It really suits you—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Oh, hold on!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Yeah! These deep red roses suit you the best after all!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I swear on this rose.
I will—without fail—make my dream come true!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I will bestow destiny upon every Umamusume,
and bring happiness to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I need you!
Lend me your strength!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Alright, let's keep moving forward!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Destiny unfolds, leading toward a glorious future!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia smiles full of confidence.
Looking forward to the scenery waiting at the end of her charge—let's keep pressing forward!
